description: An attack that targets the software or hardware supply chain to compromise the end users.
why_it_matters_to_soc: Supply chain attacks bypass perimeter defenses by using trusted channels. The blast radius is often massive, and the initial access may look like legitimate traffic.
risk_impact_factors: Implicit trust associated with vendor updates
Widespread deployment of the compromised software
High privileges often required by the software
defensive_actions: Monitor network traffic from update servers
Implement zero-trust architecture for third-party software
